jobs.title: Sales Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Perplexity is hiring sellers fast, and every new seller has to learn a fast-moving product line: Enterprise, Comet, Computer and the API. We're looking for a Sales Onboarding Manager to own how new sellers go from their first day to selling on their own. You'll build the program, keep it current, run it, and certify that each seller is ready before they sell independently.

This is a high-ownership, highly visible role on a small Sales Enablement team. You'll partner with the Sales Enablement Lead and work closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and Revenue Operations. Your goal is a robust, relevant, progressive and measurable ramp that gets faster as we scale.

**About the role**
------------------

The Sales Onboarding Manager owns the onboarding experience for Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives (AEs) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs), from Day 1 through field certification. You'll design the curriculum, keep it up to date as the product changes, lead the sessions yourself, manage the logistics of placing each cohort into the right sessions, and run the certifications that decide when a new hire is ready.

Company-wide new-hire orientation is owned by a separate onboarding role. Ongoing training for ramped sellers is owned by Sales Enablement. You'll partner with both so new sellers move smoothly from orientation into their sales ramp and then into working independently with ongoing training from Enablement.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own the sales onboarding program.** Co-design and run role-based ramps for BDRs and for Enterprise and Commercial AEs, including learning objectives, milestones and time-to-productivity targets for each stage. Where BDRs and AEs need the same foundations, they learn them together. Where the jobs differ, each gets its own track.
* **Build the BDR ramp.** Teach new BDRs prospecting and outbound: ideal customer profile and persona research, account and territory rules, multi-channel sequences, cold calling, cold email, qualification, and clean handoffs to AEs. Get BDRs productive in the prospecting stack, including Salesforce, Apollo and the dialer.
* **Build and maintain content.** Create and update modules, playbooks, talk tracks, demo guides, knowledge checks and self-paced content. Update materials as products, pricing, positioning and process change, and retire anything out of date.
* **Facilitate live sessions.** Lead engaging, interactive sessions (virtual and in person) on Perplexity's products, sales process, customer personas, discovery, demos, objection handling and tools. Bring in subject-matter experts from Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and top sellers.
* **Run cohort logistics.** Work with Recruiting and sales leaders to track incoming hires, assign each one to the right sessions for their role, segment and start date, and manage calendars, attendance, make-ups and pre-work.
* **Certify field readiness.** Design and run role-specific certifications using clear rubrics. For BDRs, that means cold-call, email and qualification certifications. For AEs, it means pitch, discovery and demo certifications. Both roles also certify on tools. Calibrate scoring with BDR and sales managers, give actionable feedback, and decide when a new hire is ready to sell on their own.
* **Partner with frontline managers.** Give managers visibility into each new hire's progress, flag risks early, and equip managers to reinforce onboarding through coaching and call reviews.
* **Measure and improve.** Track completion, certification pass rates and ramp attainment. For BDRs, also track activity, meetings booked and accepted, and pipeline sourced. For AEs, also track time to first meeting, pipeline and closed business. Use the data and new-hire feedback to improve the program each cohort.
* **Scale with leverage.** Use AI tools, including Perplexity's own products, to build content faster, personalize learning paths and automate repetitive logistics so the program keeps up with hiring.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

The best candidates are strong facilitators who also design programs and run operations well. You can command a room, build a curriculum from a blank page, and keep a complicated cohort calendar running smoothly. You hold a high bar for readiness and know how to tell a manager when a seller isn't there yet.

**Must-haves**

* 2–4 years in sales enablement, sales onboarding or sales training, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or AI company. Experience carrying a quota or managing sellers is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing and running a sales onboarding or ramp program end to end, with measurable impact on ramp time or productivity.
* Excellent live facilitation, virtual and in person, with sellers at different experience levels, from early-career BDRs to seasoned AEs.
* Experience designing and running certifications or skills assessments (such as cold-call, pitch, discovery or demo) using rubrics that sales managers trust.
* Strong program management and operational rigor. You can run several overlapping cohorts, schedules and stakeholders without dropping details.
* Working knowledge of modern sales methods (such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message or similar), outbound prospecting and the full sales cycle from first touch to close.
* Comfort learning technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. You can learn an AI product well enough to teach and demo it.
* Fluency with the sales tech stack, such as Salesforce, a conversation-intelligence tool and an LMS or content-management platform.
* High ownership and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment where the product changes weekly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience onboarding sellers for AI, developer or other technically complex products.
* Background in instructional design or adult learning.
* Previous experience as a BDR/SDR or as a BDR/SDR manager.

jobs.title: Research Program Manager, Safety Systems
jobs.description:
Research Program Management - San Francisco

**About the Team**

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models. We work across research, engineering, product, and policy to understand risks, develop and validate safeguards, and support responsible deployment.

Our work spans safeguards research and deployment, safety assessments, launch readiness, and trusted-access programs for advanced capabilities. We address risks including biological and cyber misuse and misalignment, with programs that strengthen safety across models and products.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring Research Program Managers across AI Safeguards and Frontier Risks Safety. You’ll lead programs that develop and improve the safeguards used across our models and products, or assess and mitigate risks associated with frontier capabilities, launches, and trusted-access programs.

You will partner with researchers development and deployment decisions. We’re looking for people who combine strong technical judgment, experience managing complex research programs, and a commitment to AI safety.

These roles are based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Shape safety programs and technical roadmaps.** Partner with research and engineering leads to define goals investments.
* **Drive safeguards development and deployment.** Translate safety research into safeguards across models and products. Maintain an end-to-end view of safeguard coverage, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement for one or more risk areas, and drive a roadmap that advances across launches.
* **Coordinate evaluations and safety assessments.** Organize capability evaluations, alignment and control assessments, adversarial testing, and safeguard stress-testing, including risks from autonomous and multi-agent systems. Support embedded assessments throughout model development, internal use, and deployment.
* **Drive safety readiness and trusted-access programs.** Coordinate safety requirements and execution across frontier model launches and deployments. Work with technical teams to define assessment scope and the evidence needed to inform safety and access decisions.
* **Turn findings into improvements.** Triage safeguard gaps, jailbreaks, and overflagging with accountable teams. Establish owners and escalation paths, track remediation and regression testing, and turn recurring issues into research and engineering improvements.
* **Strengthen the evidence behind safety decisions.** Support safety cases that connect claims to evaluations, safeguards, assumptions, and remaining uncertainty. Surface evidence gaps and unresolved risks, and communicate methods, results, limitations, and follow-up actions through assessment reports, system cards, and updates to decision-makers.
* **Build programs that scale across products.** Coordinate shared tooling and feedback workflows, privacy and security requirements, and safeguard user experience and quality assurance. Help teams apply safeguards consistently across product surfaces and upcoming launches.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have 5+ years of experience in technical safety work, owning technical programs, or related roles in fast-moving environments.
* Have led complex research or technical programs involving researchers and engineers, particularly in AI, cybersecurity, biosafety, or another field where failures can have serious consequences.
* Understand frontier AI safety concepts, including capability evaluations, alignment, control, monitoring, and safeguard robustness, and can engage substantively with technical teams.
* Can assess what evaluation results do and do not establish, including methodological limitations, uncertainty, and the difference between model capability and real-world risk.
* Can turn ambiguous questions into clear programs, make practical tradeoffs, and adjust priorities as evidence changes.
* Have worked extensively across research, engineering, and product teams and can coordinate with policy and communications partners.
* Exercise sound judgment when findings are concerning or incomplete, raise unresolved risks constructively, and communicate complex technical work clearly.
* Are motivated to help ensure increasingly capable AI systems remain beneficial and under meaningful human control.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Berkeley Master of Design (Berkeley MDes) is a professional graduate degree offered in partnership between the College of Engineering and the College of Environmental Design, with a curriculum focused on designing emerging technologies and the social and cultural contexts in which these technologies are shaped.
  
  
Berkeley MDes is a studio-based program in which students are immersed in community, collaboration, and hands-on learning. Over three semesters and one summer, students complete a total of eight required core courses and four electives. In the final semester, students develop and present a thesis project that represents the culmination of their intellectual journey in the program.
  
  
MDes is housed in Jacobs Hall, a 24,000 square foot building equipped with design studios and equipment rooms featuring the latest in digital fabrication technologies. Second and third semester MDes students have dedicated studio desks and full 24/7 access to the MDes Studio.
  
  
Jacobs Hall is managed by the Jacobs Institute for Design Innovation (Jacobs Institute) which operates a makerspace open to all UC Berkeley students, conducts undergraduate courses in design innovation, and supports learning and making at the intersection of design and technology through grants, public programming, and community building. The Jacobs Institute and MDes collaborate across their operations in order to leverage common knowledge and practices.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Academic Program Manager handles a wide range of student services duties and responsibilities for an academic department, school, college, or organization. This position provides assistance to the dean, chair, faculty, and students in academic advising, recruitment, admissions, financial aid, visa/immigration matters, the evaluation and awarding of fellowships and block grant funds, student orientation and events, career counseling, and related programs.
  
  
The Academic Program Manager serves as a strategic programmatic leader for the MDes program, managing the entire student lifecycle from recruitment and admissions to graduation. This position is responsible for driving program growth through data-informed recruitment strategies, benchmarking against national competitors, and implementing complex academic and financial policies. Additionally, the Academic Program Manager provides high-level consultative guidance to faculty and leadership and leads the design of professional development initiatives and high-visibility academic milestone events.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** November 11, 2026
  
  
For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!

COMPETENCIES:

jobs.title: Case Manager II - SF Outpatient Services
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M-F 9-5
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The Outpatient Program is specifically designed for people who struggle with substance use disorders, mental health issues or co-occurring disorders. The Outpatient Program works with high-risk populations from a variety of backgrounds. Our programs are open and welcoming to adult participants, of any gender identity. We accept the majority of participants who seek Outpatient treatment, including walk-in’s, referrals from other agencies and step-down transitional clients from residential treatment programs.
  
  
The Case Manager II is responsible for assessing treatment needs; monitoring and evaluating problem lists and progress and facilitating interdisciplinary approaches. The Case Manager II coordinates an approach to the delivery of health, substance use, mental health, and social services, linking clients with appropriate services to address specific needs and achieve stated goals. The Case Manager II’s duties include care coordination, maintaining positive working relationships with outside community partners, scheduling appointments, arranging transportation, assisting with acquiring medications, ongoing care and discharge planning, and crisis intervention.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Carries a caseload and meets service delivery goals.
* Work as an active team member and closely collaborate with team members.
* Help clients get and stay engaged in SUD treatment.
* Help clients transition between levels of care.
* Assess for opioid overdose and ensure beneficiary has Naloxone if appropriate.
* Interface with a multidisciplinary team in treatment planning and service delivery.
* Develop and assess the effectiveness of individualized treatment and consumer progress.
* Maintain documentation in compliance with agency, HIPAA, and DPH standards.
* Assist in the ongoing maintenance of consumers’ charts and other related documentation.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Program Manager.
* Arrange work schedule in accordance with the agency’s needs.
* Comply with the agency’s policies and procedures.
* Attend internal and external meetings as assigned.
* Create a safe space for clients and maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Meet expected performance standards as assigned by supervisor.
* Provide “whatever it takes” services to consumers including providing services where the consumer lives, assisting with housing, benefits, employment, education, transportation, childcare, medical and other needed services.
* Provide case management services to clients as assigned.
* Serve as a care coordinator for clients as assigned. Responsibilities include coordination of all services with other providers and completion of all coordinated care documentation.
* Provide case management services to clients as assigned.
* Assist client in developing independent living skills to promote independence and self-sufficiency.
* Assist in crisis and symptom management.
* Acts as buddy to new hires.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, and Experience
  

* High school diploma or GED.
* AOD Registration + 2 years of case management experience.

OR
  

* AOD Certification
* Valid CA Driver’s License.
* First Aid and CPR certification.
* Experience working with the criminal justice population preferred.
* Experience working successfully with issues of substance abuse, mental health, criminal background, and other potential barriers to economic self-sufficiency preferred.

Knowledge and Skills
  

* Some experience providing case management services is required.
* Culturally competent and able to work with a diverse population.
* Knowledge of housing, employment, SSI resources, and success with linking clients.
* Ability to enter data into various electronic systems while maintaining the integrity and accuracy of the data.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work cooperatively and effectively as part of an interdisciplinary team and independently assume responsibility.
* Strong initiative and enthusiasm and willingness to pitch in whenever needed.
* Able to communicate well at all levels of the organization including working with organization leadership and high-level representatives of partner organizations.
* Able to work within a frequently changing project scope while maintaining overall direction and structured priorities.
* Knowledge of co-occurring disorders and trauma-informed treatment.

jobs.title: People Operations & Mobility Specialist
jobs.description:
Rondo is accelerating industry's transition to lower-cost, zero-carbon heat and power.

Our Rondo Heat Batteries turn low-cost renewable electricity into continuous, high-temperature heat and power, enabling industrial facilities to replace fossil-fired boilers without costly process changes. The result is lower-cost, zero-carbon industrial energy delivered safely, reliably, and at 98% efficiency.

**Rondo is commercially deployed and rapidly scaling, today.** Backed by world-class industrial leaders and investors — including Breakthrough Energy, Energy Impact Partners, Rio Tinto, Aramco, SABIC, SCG, TITAN, Microsoft, H&M, and John Doerr — Rondo is building the next generation of industrial energy infrastructure at global scale.

We are looking for a People Operations Specialist to run the day-to-day engine of our global People function. You will own international employee lifecycle operations, global mobility, and our platform for EOR employees and contractors. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting the details right. This role will have a huge impact on both Rondo's overall operations & the employee experience!

  

**What You Will Do** *(key responsibilities for this role include but are not limited to):*

**People Operations**

* Own end-to-end employee lifecycle operations (onboarding, job changes, leaves, offboarding) for U.S. and international employees.

* Maintain accurate HRIS data and produce headcount, turnover and compliance reports for the People team and Finance.

* Draft, update and roll out People policies.

* Coordinate benefits enrollment, renewals and employee questions with brokers and vendors.

* Partner with Finance on payroll inputs, equity administration handoffs and audit requests.

* Serve as a first point of contact for employee questions, escalating employee-relations matters appropriately.

**Global mobility and immigration**

* Support the People team in managing the visa and immigration case portfolio (H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, green cards and non-U.S. work permits), working alongside external immigration counsel.

* Track deadlines, renewals and I-9 / right-to-work compliance across all countries where we employ people.

* Coordinate international assignments, relocations and business-travel compliance, including tax and social-security considerations.

* Help build repeatable processes, templates and guides so employees and managers know what to expect.

**G****lobal employment**

* Manage relationships with international offices and service providers, including employers of record (EORs), to coordinate onboarding, contracts, amendments, terminations, and payments for employees and international contractors.

* Run monthly payroll and contractor-payment cycles in partnership with Finance where the function is not fully assumed in country.

* Support entity setups and provider-to-entity transitions as Rondo expands into new countries.

* Keep providers and our core HRIS in sync, and look for automation and AI-enabled improvements.

  

**What you will bring**

* 5–8 years of People Operations or HR generalist experience, including at least 2 years supporting employees outside the U.S.

* Hands-on experience administering EOR employees and contractors, including onboarding, contracts and payment cycles.

* Direct experience managing U.S. immigration cases with outside counsel, and familiarity with work permits in other countries.

* Working knowledge of U.S. employment compliance (I-9, FLSA, leave laws) and how requirements differ internationally.

* Strong HRIS skills and comfort with data: building reports, auditing records and spotting errors before they become problems.

* Sound judgment and discretion with confidential employee information.

* Clear written and verbal communication with employees, managers, vendors and counsel across time zones.

* Comfort working independently in a lean, fast-moving team where you build processes as you go.

  

**Bonus points**

* Experience in a high-growth energy, climate-tech, industrial, manufacturing or hardware company.

* Supported hiring in Europe, the Middle East or Australia, including EOR-to-entity transitions.

* Experience implementing or scaling an HRIS across multiple countries.

* SHRM-CP, PHR, CIPD or a global mobility certification (e.g., GMS).

  

**What We Offer:**

* Comprehensive Medical Benefits

* Dental & Vision Benefits

* Life Insurance and ADD

* Up to 12 paid holidays per year, in addition to a company week-long holiday in December

* Flexible time off policy

* 401(k) plan with company match

* Cell Phone Reimbursement

* Catered lunches on-site

* Rondo HQ is close to Oakland airport - one block from the Bay - and has stunning Bay views

* An opportunity to make a huge positive impact on the planet

  

This role necessitates being on-site Alameda, California. The estimated annual salary range for a candidate in the Bay Area for this role is between $120,000 and $135,000, plus equity in an early-stage, rapidly scaling global company. Additionally, you would be eligible for Rondo's excellent benefits listed above. Please note that some pay bands may have wide ranges of compensation to accommodate candidates' diverse sets of skill levels, experience, and geographic locations.

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. ------------

We are currently seeking a Customer Experience T3 Specialist to join our team. In this role, you’ll be the voice of Instacart, delivering exceptional service through real-time calls and occasionally emails. You’ll work directly with customers, shoppers, pharmacists, and retail partners to create personalized support experiences that reflect empathy, kindness, and professionalism. Your work will focus on ensuring customer satisfaction by supporting Instacart Health initiatives like Fresh Funds and delivery-related inquiries for Rx orders, helping users during the moments that matter most.

The Instacart Customer Experience Consumer Vanguard team is dedicated to supporting a range of interactions across our customer, shopper, retailer, and partner community. From assisting with inquiries about Fresh Funds under our Instacart Health initiative to supporting Rx customers with prescription delivery and related questions, we provide empathetic and solutions-focused service. Whether resolving app issues or troubleshooting delivery concerns, our team is committed to advocating on behalf of our users and creating exceptional support experiences that contribute to Instacart’s vision of accessible and reliable services for all.

**About the Job**
-----------------

* Take ownership of delivering real-time support to customers with a focus on Rx delivery-related inquiries and Instacart Health programs like Fresh Funds.
* Leverage exceptional problem-solving skills to provide fast, effective resolutions while navigating complex and evolving challenges at scale.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment where processes may rapidly change, and new priorities emerge without warning.
* Communicate clearly, empathetically, and professionally across all interactions, ensuring a personalized and meaningful service experience that builds lasting trust.
* Embrace operational ownership by proactively identifying trends in customer feedback and collaborating with your Manager to streamline processes and improve outcomes.

**About You**
-------------

***Minimum Qualifications***

* 1+ years of experience in customer service or call center support, with a proven ability to handle high-pressure scenarios.
* Superior communication skills, including clear and professional phone etiquette and excellent written skills.
* Comfort and proficiency with technology, from navigating web-based support platforms to using and troubleshooting smartphone apps (iPhone/Android).
* A proven ability to multitask, prioritize, and problem-solve in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
* A strong sense of empathy, customer advocacy, and sound judgment for creating positive outcomes in difficult or time-sensitive situations.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience in delivery-focused customer support, particularly within delivery apps
* Familiarity with handling inbound customer service calls and/or working within HIPAA-compliant environments.
* Prior experience in a fast-paced, metrics-driven contact center setting.
* Proficiency with customer support tools like Salesforce, Geneys, Admin or similar platforms.
* A demonstrated ability to identify trends and provide feedback for continuous improvement in processes and workflows*.*

***Work Schedule:***

jobs.title: Creative Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Government Employees Health Association, Inc. (G.E.H.A) is a nonprofit member association that provides health and dental benefits that millions of federal employees and retirees, military retirees and their families have counted on since 1937. Offering one of the largest health and dental benefit provider networks available to federal employees in the United States, G.E.H.A empowers health and wellness by meeting its members where they are, when they need care.

G.E.H.A has one mission: To empower federal workers to be healthy and well.

The Creative Operations Coordinator works closely with Traffic team peers, Traffic Manager, Growth Strategy Managers, Member Communication Managers, members of the Creative Services team and the Creative Director to manage proofing cycles, facilitate communication and assign personnel based on resourcing. Through keeping projects organized, efficient and aligned across stakeholders, the Creative Operations Coordinator supports consistent and high-quality execution. This role and ideal candidate have an eye for detail, exceptional organization skills, advanced Workfront project management and administration skills ability to manage multiple projects and have a background in working with creative teams.

**SKILLS**
----------

* Creates and manages proofing review cycles by assigning reviewers and driving and timely stakeholder approval decisions, including regular follow-up on outstanding approvals.
* Monitors task status and deadlines using dashboards and team meetings, follows up on late tasks, adjusts schedules, and escalates risks as needed.
* Gathers and maintains clear documentation of key decisions, schedule changes, and project updates.

Uses reports and dashboards that provide visibility into project status, workload, and operational performance to track progress and flag concerns.

* 3 years of experience working with creative teams; partnering with designers and copywriters to generate high‑volume work in a regulated environment.
* Strong organizational abilities with the capacity to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and details in a high-volume environment.
* Clear and effective communication skills, ensuring timely updates, smooth collaboration, and alignment across teams.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a positive, solution-focused attitude that helps overcome challenges and keep projects moving forward.
* Comfortable taking ownership of projects and maintaining accountability for timely and accurate delivery.
* Ability to work independently while knowing when to collaborate.
* Proficiency working in project management systems/platforms, like Workfront.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Supporting an assigned book of business strategically to achieve objectives, including relationship, growth, retention, and customer goals. Including Manage risks and developing opportunities associated with current clients
* Cultivate productive, trusted relationships with key executives – including C-level and both internal and external stakeholders of relationships
* Utilize data-driven resources to run efficient/effective meetings and work sessions with the client and all relevant Subject Matter Expert (SME)s
* Possess deep subject matter expertise on program value and operations for Evolent’s Advance Care Planning and member-facing products
* Lead regular Partnership review meetings for each client, including relationship mapping, issue identification, and action planning, in lead up to scheduled Client Value Meetings
* Advocate for partner culture, serve as an ambassador within Evolent and the go-to expert on client priorities and how to get things done within the health plan organization
* Aggressively manage all aspects of the contracts with assigned clients as well as ensure ongoing contract performance through risk management activities including assurance of Service Level Agreement performance, rate/savings maximization through ongoing benefit analysis and adherence to requirements of the client’s legal and regulatory environment
* Willingness to travel once a year for a team onsite (usually 2-3 days)

**Qualifications**

* Bachelors’ Degree or equivalent work experience
* 1+ or more years in client or account management roles
* Ability to find creative solutions in an ever changing and growing environment
* Demonstrated ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including at the C-level
* 2+ years broad-based Health Plan experience
* Exceptionally high “Emotional Intelligence” and ability to connect with diverse constituents, actively listen, and identify key areas of sensitivity

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**Technical Requirements:**

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

**Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.**

The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $75,000-80,000. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

**Job Overview**

The Director of School Operations (DSO) is a senior, enterprise-level leadership role responsible for operational excellence across a portfolio of Connections Academy schools. The DSO focuses on strengthening the effectiveness of school leaders and leadership teams through hands‑on partnership, coaching, and operational problem‑solving. This role directly manages the primary school leader and at each school will work directly with principals, directors, and school leadership teams to ensure schools are operationally strong, well‑supported, and positioned to serve students successfully.

The DSO uses a multi-layer leadership model to ensure alignment and execution of school operations to PVS standards and values. This is accomplished by supporting operational systems, compliance structures, and leadership accountability through school-based leadership teams. The scope of this role is inherently complex and high-impact, requiring a majority of time spent working directly with schools, the ability to lead leaders, operate at scale, and balance competing priorities across multiple schools and PVS simultaneously.

The DSO works in a number of cross-functional teams identified as key members to accomplish school goals. jobs.title: Operations and Project Manager
jobs.description:
Loffa Interactive Group builds the software broker-dealers use to meet rules that once took a room full of people: Letters of Free Funds under Regulation T, quarterly broker statements, and prime brokerage agreements. We've done this since 2002. We're a small, fully remote company, and our clients include some of the largest firms on Wall Street.

We need one person to run our projects and our operations team. That work sits with people who are moving on to other jobs here, so you'd take it over and report to our COO.

**A year from now**

Every active project has one current plan and a named owner for each milestone. Our new platform has its first client live, and you ran the QA and go/no-go checks that got it there. The operations team brings its escalations to you. You've carried the evidence for one SOC 1 and SOC 2 audit cycle, and you've answered client vendor reviews on your own.

**What you'll do**

* Own the plan for every project. The new platform comes first. Keep dates, risks, and decisions current, and chase each open item until it has an owner and an answer.
* Run the delivery routine with our developers and QA in Jira, from sprint planning through release readiness.
* Manage the operations team. They run verification and statement work for our clients and track down counterparties when something goes wrong.
* Turn what clients and the team tell you into requirements. Our quarterly statement and prime brokerage products both started when a client described a manual process to us.
* Cover compliance about 10% of the time. You'd answer client vendor reviews and keep policies and audit evidence current. We'll teach you how we do it.
* Use AI tools every day. Ours compare a vendor questionnaire against our policies and file call notes into Jira tickets. You'd use them and make them better.

**What's hard about it**

This job doesn't work from a distance. You'd read the tickets, join the calls, and know on any given day what's stuck and why. If you'd rather oversee through status reports, it's the wrong job.

You'd also be our only project manager, with no project office behind you. And our market takes time to learn. Even with broker-dealer experience, expect months before the whole picture of how firms use our products makes sense.

**Required**

* Experience at or for a broker-dealer, clearing firm, custodian, or prime broker. Any function counts, including operations, compliance, technology, project work, or a vendor serving those firms.
* You've led a project across more than one team, from plan to delivery, as a project manager, team lead, or operations lead.
* Some hands-on time with software delivery: Jira or a similar tool, a Scrum team, or coding of any kind. A little is fine.
* Authorized to work in the United States and available during US business hours.

**Preferred**

* You've managed an operations team or directed its daily work.
* You've personally run project mechanics such as tickets, standups, user acceptance testing, trackers, or written requirements.
* Exposure to compliance work: written policies, vendor risk reviews, SOC audits, or FINRA or SEC exams.
* Experience with Letters of Free Funds, SIA-150 and SIA-151 prime brokerage agreements, or quarterly open position statements.
* A Scrum or PMP certification, SQL or scripting, FINRA licenses, or regular use of AI tools at work.

**Bonus and benefits**

You'd join our profit-sharing plan, which pays out as cash bonuses and 401(k) contributions. Your share depends on company results, your performance, and your tenure, and your title and salary don't figure into it. Profit sharing isn't guaranteed.

We also offer health insurance, a 401(k) with company matching, short-term and long-term disability coverage, paid time off that grows with tenure, and 10 paid market holidays.

The job is fully remote. We have no office to commute to, and travel is rare.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed by 4 December 2026. Include your resume, and tell us about a project you ran and what you personally did on it.

We use AI tools to help organize and compare applications. A person on our team makes every hiring decision. Offers depend on reference checks, a criminal background check, and a pre-employment drug and alcohol screen.

Loffa Interactive Group is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation to apply, email info@loffacorp.com.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Have you worked at or for a broker-dealer, clearing firm, custodian, prime broker, or a vendor serving them?
* Describe a cross-team project you led and what you personally did on it.
* Which have you used hands-on: Jira or similar, a Scrum team, SQL or code, or none?
* What base pay are you looking for?
* In a sentence or two, what does a clearing firm do that an introducing broker doesn't?

**About Vivid Life Home Care**
------------------------------

Vivid Life Home Care is a growing network of worker-owned home care cooperatives across California operating under a shared brand and centralized back-office support structure (Vivid Life Cooperative Headquarters). Our mission is to provide world-class home care that blends the best traditions of caregiving with modern, proven practices to create vibrant futures for all.

We partner with independent organizations, including nonprofits and community-based institutions, to build a cooperative ecosystem that improves access to quality care while uplifting caregivers as worker-owners.

**About Our Cooperative Model**
-------------------------------

### **What is a Worker-Owned Cooperative?**

A worker-owned cooperative is an organization owned and governed by its worker-members. In this model, caregivers and staff are not just employees—they are member-owners who participate in decision-making and share in the economic and organizational success of the cooperative.

Key principles include:

* **Democratic governance:** Members participate in decisions that affect their cooperative
* **Shared ownership:** Members contribute to and benefit from organizational performance
* **Local autonomy:** Each cooperative maintains decision-making authority within shared system standards
* **Shared services model:** Headquarters provides centralized systems, infrastructure, compliance, and operational support

Vivid Life operates as a network of independent cooperatives connected through shared systems, standards, and brand infrastructure.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing centralized systems, infrastructure, and daily operational performance across Vivid Life Home Care. This role ensures that Client Success Representatives (CSRs), Cooperative Admins, and caregiver member-owners across the cooperative network are fully supported to deliver high-quality, dignified care through efficient and scalable systems.

This leader serves as the operational backbone of the organization, connecting caregiver experience, client service delivery, and administrative infrastructure into a seamless, high-performing system.

This role combines systems management, training, technical support, implementation leadership, and data analysis across core platforms to drive operational consistency and efficiency.

This is not a traditional operations role. The person in this role will be supporting existing and new co-ops, including supporting caregivers and clients on a day-to-day basis. This will require the Operations Manager to be available and on-call outside of traditional working hours.The Operations Manager serves as the steward of shared infrastructure—creating and establishing standardized systems while preserving cooperative autonomy and local governance authority. This position works under the direction of the Director of Operations and Business Development and requires flexibility to support occasional after-hours and weekend operational needs.

Fortwyn Advisory is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Project Coordinator with experience in the automotive dealership industry to support dealership acquisitions, ownership transitions, and OEM franchise approval processes.

This fully remote position plays a critical role in coordinating communications, managing documentation, monitoring deadlines, and ensuring transaction requirements are addressed accurately and efficiently.

The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) representatives, acquisition teams, legal and finance professionals, licensing agencies, and dealership leadership to facilitate approvals and keep transactions progressing toward closing.

Reporting directly to the President of Fortwyn Advisory, the Project Coordinator must demonstrate strong organizational skills, professional communication, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Responsibilities**

**OEM Relations & Franchise Approvals**

* Serve as a point of contact with OEM representatives throughout dealership acquisitions and ownership changes.
* Coordinate factory approval applications, required documentation, supplemental information requests, and submission timelines.
* Review OEM franchise requirements early in each transaction to identify potential issues that could affect approvals or closing.
* Monitor approval conditions, communicate decisions, and ensure outstanding requirements are addressed within established deadlines.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with OEM representatives while staying informed of relevant manufacturer policies, franchise requirements, and dealer-network program changes.

**Project & Transaction Coordination**

* Coordinate with legal counsel, financial professionals, licensing agencies, dealership leadership, and acquisition teams to ensure application materials are accurate, complete, and submitted on time.
* Track multiple concurrent projects, maintaining organized records of deadlines, outstanding documentation, approvals, and action items.
* Provide timely project updates to the President and relevant stakeholders, identifying potential delays or obstacles requiring attention.
* Maintain accurate and confidential project documentation, correspondence, and transaction records.

**Licensing & Ownership Transitions**

* Coordinate with internal and external service providers to support business entity formation, regulatory filings, dealership licensing, and related administrative requirements.
* Assist with post-approval ownership transitions, including required OEM account updates, dealership records, and operational changes.
* Monitor outstanding licensing and transition requirements to support successful transaction completion.

**Required Qualifications**

* Professional experience within the automotive dealership industry, including dealership operations, franchise administration, OEM relations, or related functions.
* Proven experience in project coordination, transaction administration, executive support, or a related professional role.
* Strong understanding of automotive dealership operations and manufacturer-dealer relationships.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and multiple deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to interact professionally with senior executives and external stakeholders.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in documentation and recordkeeping.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage follow-ups, track outstanding requirements, and maintain project momentum.
* Ability to handle sensitive business and financial information with professionalism and confidentiality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with dealership acquisitions, franchise approvals, or dealership ownership transitions.
* Familiarity with OEM franchise application processes, manufacturer requirements, and dealership licensing procedures.
* Experience coordinating with legal, financial, regulatory, or corporate transaction teams.
* Knowledge of mergers and acquisitions processes, corporate filings, or business entity formation.

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
Overview:

Goldbelt Professional Services, LLC (GPS) specializes in providing support and expert resources for an extensive range of public health missions, including scientific, technical, and administrative support ranging from junior staff to high-level subject matter experts. We are research- and data-driven, with a team of experts ready to create solutions and customized support tailored to our clients' needs.

**Summary:**

The **Program Manager II** will support the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion (NCCDPHP). The Program Manager will provide project and program management support to help the Office of the Director (OD) organize, prioritize, and manage its responsibilities across the Center, working with divisions as internal customers to identify needs and coordinate support. This role requires a seasoned project management professional with strong organizational and operational judgment who can anticipate when processes or projects need to pivot, respond to high-level organizational requests, and support data- and budget-related decision-making in a dynamic, evolving environment.

This position is based in the Atlanta, GA area. Work may be performed at a CDC facility and/or via telework as determined by contract needs.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Provide project and program management support to the Center's Office of the Director, helping to organize, prioritize, and manage the OD's responsibilities across the Center.
* Work with divisions as internal customers to identify their needs and coordinate appropriate support and solutions.
* Respond to high-level organizational requests and information needs, including locating, compiling, and analyzing information to support timely and accurate responses.
* Develop and implement project management tools, governance structures, and tracking systems to standardize and strengthen program and project delivery.
* Support budget- and resource-related activities and decision-making, including preparing and reviewing supporting documentation and analysis.
* Identify projects, activities, and functions that would benefit from enhanced project management support and recommend approaches to improve them.
* Anticipate and support change management, transition, and process improvement needs, including determining when a process or project should pivot and planning accordingly.
* Develop and update dashboards and other tools to monitor projects, track deadlines, and identify risks.
* Create strategic communications and engage stakeholders to support decision-making as priorities emerge and evolve.
* Support strategic planning and related efforts at the Center and OD level.
* Provide workgroup and meeting support and adapt quickly to shifting organizational priorities and timelines.

Qualifications:

**Necessary Skills and Knowledge:**

* Demonstrated experience managing projects and programs, including planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong organizational and operational skills, with the judgment to anticipate needs, manage change, and determine when processes or projects need to pivot.
* Ability to locate, compile, and analyze information quickly to respond to organizational and leadership requests.
* Ability to develop project management tools, governance structures, tracking systems, and dashboards to monitor performance and identify risks.
* Experience leading change management, transition, and process improvement efforts.
* Familiarity with budget and resource processes and the ability to support budget-related decision-making.
* Strong strategic communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders and support leadership decision-making.
* Ability to identify, prioritize, and respond to emerging priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and project management tools.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* A minimum of 5 years of documented experience working with CDC, federal, or related public health entities; OR a bachelor's degree in health, science, public health administration, policy, or a functionally related field plus at least 2 years of documented experience working with CDC, federal, or related public health entities.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a CDC Public Trust clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Deep familiarity with the CDC, including its organizational structure, operations, and established processes, with the ability to navigate the agency effectively and know where and how to obtain needed information.
* Senior-level experience, typically 10 or more years, in project or program management, preferably supporting a federal public health agency or similar large, complex organization.
* Understanding of the CDC or federal budgeting process and experience supporting budget-related decisions.
* Master's degree in public health, public administration, business administration, or a related field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience supporting an Office of the Director or other executive/leadership-level function.
* Experience with strategic planning, change management, or organizational transition initiatives in a public health or federal environment.

**Pay and Benefits**

The salary range for this position is $100,000.00-$150,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings

**Travel Project Manager - Field Installations**  
Are you an experienced team leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys extensive travel?

Graphic Information Systems (GIS) is seeking a Travel Project Manager to oversee nationwide warehouse signage and labeling projects for our Fortune 500 clients across the U.S. and Canada. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring 85% travel (approximately 10+ months per year).  
GIS specializes in warehouse inventory control solutions, including the installation of labeling and signage systems for major distribution centers throughout North America.  
  
As a Travel Project Manager, you’ll lead teams of hourly and temporary employees on-site to ensure successful execution of labeling projects. You will manage daily operations, materials, safety, and client communication from project launch to completion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and supervise installation teams (5+ employees) to meet project goals on time and within budget.
* Understand and manage the full scope of each project: materials, logistics, timelines, and customer specifications.
* Act as the primary liaison between GIS and the client’s on-site representatives.
* Monitor and report on resources, equipment, project scope, delays, and quality issues.
* Conduct on-site training related to safety, equipment usage (e.g., forklifts, scissor lifts), and installation procedures.
* Ensure strict adherence to federal and site-specific safety policies.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of experience managing or supervising teams of 5 or more.
* Willing and able to travel 85% of the year (10+ months) across the U.S. and Canada.
* Comfortable working at heights up to 40 feet.
* Must be willing to become certified to operate and train others on forklifts, scissor lifts, and boom lifts.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving and time management abilities.
* Comfortable working under tight deadlines and managing multiple projects.
* Customer service oriented and professional when working with high-profile clients.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Hourly rate $24 - $30 while traveling / working (Hourly rate based on experience and other qualifications)
* Company-paid/reimbursed travel expenses and Per Diems
* Health, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance (effective the 1st of the month after hire)
* FSA and HSA
* Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) – up to $2,000 per year
* 401(k) plan with a match and profit sharing
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Performance-based bonuses

* Graphic Information Systems (GIS) is unable to offer sponsorship for employment visas at this time. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements. We appreciate your understanding and encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Capital Markets
jobs.description:
Terrion, Inc. is an advanced carbon materials company building a fully domestic production pathway for synthetic graphite and graphene. Our patent-pending Carbonyx™ process converts purchased Pennsylvania anthracite into three co-produced materials, synthetic graphite powder, high-density fine-grain graphite blocks, and graphene, using a single integrated process rather than three separate supply chains.

Graphite is a designated critical material. The United States imports the overwhelming majority of the synthetic graphite it consumes, and domestic capacity is limited. Terrion exists to change that. We are venture-backed and part of the IBX family of companies. Terrion operates an active research and development laboratory in Gaithersburg, Maryland, is building out a pilot production facility near Frederick, and will build commercial manufacturing facilities at sites now being selected. We are executing federally funded programs, including work under an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA), to build production capability and deliver against government milestones.

Terrion is at the transition point between demonstrated science and manufactured product. That transition is a delivery problem, not a research problem. This role exists to execute it, first at the pilot plant and then at commercial scale.

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Project Manager, Capital Projects, is Terrion's on-site owner of capital project delivery. The role first leads the build-out of the pilot production facility near Frederick, from construction and equipment installation through commissioning and operational readiness, against schedules and milestones set by Terrion's federally funded programs. As Terrion moves to commercial scale, the role then leads delivery of the first commercial plant, which is expected to be a substantially larger facility at a site still being selected.

This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory layer above a controls staff. The Senior Project Manager personally builds and maintains the project schedule, cost baseline, and risk register using tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or Excel, and is Terrion's day-to-day point of accountability for the construction, engineering, and vendor partners on each project. Technical design and engineering decisions sit with the Director of Engineering and Terrion's technical leads. This role owns the schedule, budget, coordination, and delivery around them.

**What You Will Do**

**Pilot Facility Build-Out and Commissioning**

* Lead the build-out of the pilot production facility near Frederick, serving as Terrion's on-site project lead from construction through equipment installation, commissioning, and turnover to operations

* Hold Terrion's construction project manager, general contractor, architects, outside engineering firm, and trade contractors accountable to committed dates, including recovery planning when schedules slip

* Coordinate permitting, occupancy, and utility readiness with local authorities, and work with the environmental, safety, and health lead to keep the site compliant with state and local requirements

* Drive long-lead capital equipment procurement to schedule, tracking vendors, purchase orders, lead times, delivery, installation sequencing, and warranty terms, based on specifications developed by the Director of Engineering

* Integrate design, layout, utility, and regulatory requirements across the project so decisions are made with the full site picture in view

* Be on site daily once construction is underway

**Commercial Plant Delivery**

* Lead project delivery for Terrion's first commercial manufacturing plant, carrying lessons from the pilot facility into the commercial schedule, budget, and contracting approach

* Establish the integrated schedule, cost baseline, and contractor and vendor structure for the commercial plant, and travel to the site as construction and commissioning require

* Support site selection, proposal development, and capital planning with schedule basis, basis of estimate, and staffing plans

**Schedule, Cost, and Risk Control**

* Build and maintain the integrated schedule and cost baseline for each project, including budget development, commitment and accrual tracking, variance analysis, estimate at completion, and resource-loading to the work package level

* Administer scope, schedule, and cost changes through a formal change-control process

* Maintain a risk register with a named owner and mitigation plan for each risk, and report top risks and status during program reviews

* Prepare milestone evidence packages, monthly technical and financial reports, and quarterly program reviews, and report regularly on schedule, cost, progress, risks, and required decisions

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate functional leads across engineering, quality, safety, environmental and health, supply chain, procurement, finance, and operations

* Run the project operating cadence, coordinate with company leadership on agreement administration and flow-down obligations, and escalate schedule, cost, resource, or performance issues early enough to allow corrective action

* Help establish the project management processes, tools, and systems a growing company needs to manage capital projects, track deliverables, and report performance

**What You Bring**

We are targeting project managers with 10 or more years of experience delivering hardware, equipment, facilities, or manufactured products against a customer's contract requirements. The strongest candidates have carried a capital expansion, new production line, new facility, or contract production program from plan to delivery, and can describe what slipped, why, and what they did about it.

* Approximately 10 or more years of career experience, with a core focus on leading complex engineering, capital, or industrial manufacturing projects

* Direct responsibility for sizable projects or programs (ideally $10 million or more in total

**About the role**
------------------

As Senior Program Manager, Contingent Workforce, you will lead the strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of Zillow Group’s contingent workforce program. Reporting to the Senior Manager of ES&O Programs, you’ll lead a team responsible for business partnership, supplier management, systems, and program operations.

  

In this highly cross-functional role, you’ll partner with Strategic Sourcing, HR Compliance, Product & Technology, IT, Finance, Legal, and the Employee Service Center to strengthen centralized processes, governance, and service delivery. You’ll translate program strategy into actionable roadmaps, develop internal capabilities, and guide the program’s international expansion while supporting the needs of contingent workers, hiring managers, and the business.

  

### **You Will**

* Lead the end-to-end strategy, operations, and continuous improvement of the contingent workforce program, strengthening centralized ownership within ES&O through clear decision-making authority, consistent program standards, and defined responsibilities across partner teams.
* Lead the evolution of the contingent workforce operating model, including bringing key program functions in-house, managing knowledge transfer, and establishing clear ownership, documented processes, and cross-functional handoffs to ensure operational readiness and continuity.
* Lead and develop the contingent workforce program team, setting priorities, coaching team members, and establishing clear accountability across business partnership, supplier management, systems, and operations.
* Develop and execute a roadmap for international expansion, partnering with Legal, Strategic Sourcing, and regional People teams to assess local requirements, establish supplier and service delivery models, and implement scalable processes.
* Design and maintain a program framework that defines intake, engagement models, worker classification, and lifecycle management for staffing, independent contractor, employer-of-record, and statement-of-work engagements in partnership with the appropriate business and functional owners.
* Establish program governance and controls across worker classification, engagement approvals, assignment duration, onboarding and offboarding, and supplier compliance, partnering with Legal and HR Compliance to address risks and exceptions.
* Oversee and improve hiring and onboarding workflows, partnering with IT, suppliers, and operational teams to coordinate timely hardware, software, and access provisioning.
* Own the contingent workforce systems roadmap and business requirements, partnering with Product & Technology and Procurement Systems to strengthen Beeline and Workday integrations, improve data integrity, and deliver automation and system enhancements.
* Establish scalable financial and supplier management processes with Finance, Procurement, and Strategic Sourcing, including invoice reconciliation, issue resolution, supplier performance monitoring, and contingent workforce spend reporting.
* Lead program-side supplier lifecycle management, including onboarding, performance reviews, issue resolution, and renewal planning; partner with Strategic Sourcing and Procurement on supplier evaluation, RFPs, commercial negotiations, and sourcing strategies.
* Define and monitor program performance measures across service delivery, compliance, data quality, supplier performance, and spend; use insights to prioritize improvements and communicate results, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
* Deliver actionable workforce and spend insights to People partners and business leaders to support workforce planning, budget forecasting, and contingent worker visibility.
* Develop self-service guidance, training, and communications that help managers, HRBPs, suppliers, and operational partners understand program requirements and navigate support channels.
* Serve as the point of escalation for complex program issues, coordinating resolution across internal teams and external partners.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives from discovery through implementation, including project planning, stakeholder alignment, change management, and adoption.
* Deliver a consistent, well-supported contingent worker and manager experience through clear onboarding, access, support, and offboarding processes appropriate to each engagement type.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. jobs.title: Senior Information Assurance Analyst / Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC**

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC, we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

**Location:** This is a US-based remote position, with occasional on-site visits to Arlington, VA as required (travel at employee's expense).

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Security Clearance:** No security clearance required. Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Job Summary**
---------------

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking a Senior Information Assurance (IA) Analyst / Program Manager to support the Headquarters, Department of the Army G-1, Directorate of Prevention, Resilience, and Readiness (DPRR) Information Assurance Support Services (IASS) program. This key personnel role leads the Information Assurance program for the Drug and Alcohol Management Information System (DAMIS), the Risk Reduction Unit Risk Inventory Application, and associated standalone applications hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud. Serving as the Information Assurance Security Officer (IASO) and the Contracting Officer Representative's (COR) main point of contact, this position owns Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate (ATO) maintenance and reauthorization, and supervises the IA Analyst. Core hours are 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the overall Information Assurance program for DAMIS under the direction of the System Owner/COR and the Program Information Systems Security Manager (P-ISSM), serving as IASO and the COR's main point of contact.
* Manage the system's Risk Management Framework (RMF) process; prepare, coordinate, and submit security documentation for review and routing to the approving authority, and adapt to changing requirements from TBAI, Army CIO, or DoW.
* Use the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) to obtain and maintain the system ATO; perform weekly continuous monitoring of ATO requirements, STIGs, and Control Correlation Identifiers (CCIs) and report weekly ATO status with a remediation plan.
* Develop and maintain the RMF modernization and timeline plan with ATO milestones, and prepare and submit the ATO reauthorization package in eMASS before the current ATO expires.
* Manage the vulnerability compliance report and lead annual contingency, security, and recovery tests, submitting documentation within 2 business days of test completion.
* Prepare FISMA-compliant reports and update information assurance data in the Army Portfolio Management System (APMS), Army Asset & Vulnerability Tracking Resource (A&VTR), and eMASS.
* Prepare and submit the Monthly Status Report (MSR) on RMF compliance, challenges, issues, and prior-month activity.
* Serve as a member of the agency's Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT), acknowledging incidents within 15 minutes and initiating approved mitigation within one hour during duty hours; maintain the Emergency Operations Plan.
* Review system change requests and recommend implementation or alternatives based on IA vulnerabilities within 2 business days.
* Attend IA working groups, conferences, and recurring meetings virtually or in person, and provide minutes and recommendations within 2 business days.
* Supervise the IA Analyst, review deliverables for quality, and provide backup coverage for IA Analyst tasks.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
* At least 6 years of technical and compliance experience maintaining a system's security posture and managing security within a Microsoft Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environment.
* At least 2 years of experience leading teams.
* Proven IA/cybersecurity experience managing the security posture of systems involving .NET, Windows, Azure, Oracle, and Red Hat.
* Strong background in data architecture, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Red Hat and Windows security and administration.
* Extensive experience implementing and auditing against DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists to oversee RMF processes and continuous monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain a system's ATO and obtain a new ATO.
* Experience using eMASS.
* Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical staff, program leadership, and Government stakeholders.
* Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation prior to start.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with ACAS, SCAP Compliance Checker, and DISA STIG Viewer.
* Experience supporting systems through RMF changes such as the transition from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 4 to Revision 5.
* Experience supporting Army systems hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud.
* Experience with systems handling Privacy Act, PII, or HIPAA-protected data.
* Experience with FISMA reporting in APMS and A&VTR.

**Certifications**
------------------

* Active Tier 3 (NACI) or higher background investigation prior to start.
* DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (e.g., CISSP, CGRC/CAP, CISM, GSLC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment.
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment. CISSP satisfies both IAM Level II and IAT Level II.

jobs.description:

DoorDash's Product Marketing Operations team is the connective tissue between our Retention Marketing organization and the tools, systems, and data that power it. You'll make sure our CRM teams have everything they need for a frictionless process while building campaigns.
