jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.

PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn’t be higher.

We’re look for a Program Manager to oversee the FedRAMP certification process, as well as ongoing management and evolution of our existing compliance commitments, including SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS compliance. PlanetScale’s security and compliance team is responsible for our corporate information security program, with a goal to reduce risk across our systems, and to establish trust in our product offerings, features, and cloud services. Our work is focused on both our internal employees and our external customers and partners.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Take primary responsibility for overseeing PlanetScale’s FedRAMP readiness and ATO process from start to finish
* Act as the main compliance point of contact for all audits/assessments (i.e. SOC 1 & 2, PCI, FedRAMP) including audit plan preparation, review of documentation and evidence, evaluation of procedures, and external walkthroughs
* Establish, track, and report on key performance indicators and maturity metrics related to audit and compliance programs
* Work collaboratively across many internal teams (IT, Engineering, Legal, and People) to identify, manage, and implement solutions related to privacy, data protection risks, and compliance requirements to help meet our customer’s high expectations for data protection and privacy
* Leverage knowledge of industry standards and best practices to assess the current state of security and compliance risks, identify areas of exposure, and continuously address the gaps by proposing and implementing remediating controls

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience contributing to and/or managing audits for a company in the technology sector, including demonstrable experience and subject matter expertise in FedRAMP.
* Experience with SOC 2 and the PCI Data Security Standard, either as a contributor or control owner.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to communicate compliance and privacy related concepts to a broad range of technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Comfort and experience in working in a remote-first organizational, oftentimes asynchronously across many teams and timezones
* Demonstrated success and comfort working with external auditors, outside consultants, and legal affairs
* Experience contributing to and/or managing companywide risk assessments
* Experience and knowledge of cloud service providers and how to interact with them (AWS, Azure, GCP)

#### **What else will help you be successful**

* Experience working with databases, developer tools, infrastructure, or other technical products
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) preferred (CISA, or CISM)
* Working knowledge of SQL, preferably with experience in MySQL and/or PostgreSQL

### **About You**

You are highly organized and able to operate in a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguous or changing situations. You thrive in an environment of cross-department collaboration and feel comfortable working without organizational silos or barriers. You have a passion to lead programs that directly impact and enable our organization to drive higher levels of success. You understand that security and compliance programs are revenue generators and directly influence our ability to sell to and maintain our most demanding customers.

You are comfortable challenging the status quo while staying laser-focused on the task at hand: keeping PlanetScale secure and earning trust with our customers.

### **Why PlanetScale**

We’re redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale — and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Customer Support Engineer, you’ll be on the front lines helping developers and businesses solve real production problems, while also shaping the product, documentation, and support systems that make PlanetScale better for every customer.

PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there’s any way we can make the interview process better for you; we’re happy to accommodate!

#### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

**Base salary range:** $175,000 - $200,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Alltus**

We build software that uses natural language processing (NLP) and AI to help local governments work faster, more accurately, and more efficiently. Over 120 local government entities in 25 states rely on us to help drive revenues and provide important services that power society.

Thrive, wherever you call home. Join our fully remote team and unlock a world of possibilities beyond just a paycheck:

* **Globally connected, locally supported:** Thrive in a vibrant online community that celebrates your unique talents, wherever you are.
* **Supportive parental leave:** Welcoming a new member to your crew? We've got your back with time and support to adjust.
* **Home office, fully equipped:** Craft your ideal workspace with our generous home office and equipment stipend.
* Plus: Flexible work arrangements, continuous learning opportunities, and much more!

This isn't just a job; it's a launchpad for personal and professional growth.

* ***Looking for candidates located in the Central, Mountain and Pacific Time Zones***

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a **Customer Success Manager** who wants real ownership, meaningful impact, and the chance to work alongside a high-performing team that moves fast and executes well.

You’ll own the end-to-end success of your accounts—driving adoption, retention, and expansion across our government customer base. This is a highly strategic role where you’ll partner closely with customers, influence product direction, and directly contribute to company growth.

As we scale, top performers will have opportunities to take on larger accounts, expand into adjacent roles, or grow into leadership.

**What You Will Work On**

* **Drive Strategic Growth & Partnerships:** Serve as a trusted, high-value advisor to customers. Develop and execute tailored account strategies to navigate unique workflows, political environments, and complex organizational dynamics, ensuring customer needs align with product capabilities.
* **Own Business Outcomes:** Proactively manage renewals and negotiate expansion opportunities, meeting annual targets tied to retention and growth. This is a critical component of the CSM role, requiring a strong background in managing contract lifecycles.
* **Enable Adoption & Value:** Partner with our customers during the critical adoption phase and provide ongoing, targeted training to maximize their success. Translate technical concepts and product updates into clear, practical value for diverse audiences.
* **Manage Success Metrics:** Monitor and report on key performance indicators, including churn reduction, expansion revenue, and Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), utilizing data to inform strategic account planning.
* **Stakeholder Mapping & Advocacy:** Identify and nurture relationships with all key decision-makers and influencers within your accounts, ensuring they receive appropriate support. Act as the voice of the customer internally, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Support teams.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years of experience in Customer Success (ideally within a fast-growing SaaS startup).
* Proven ability to manage complex accounts, drive renewals, and identify cross-sell opportunities.
* Strong focus on achieving customer outcomes and building long-term partnerships.
* Skill in navigating multiple stakeholders and a collaborative spirit for cross-functional conversations.
* Ability to mitigate risk and de-escalate issues before they become critical.
* Capacity to learn and support multiple products.
* Proficiency in translating technical concepts into practical, customer-friendly language.
* Clear, strategic communication (strong written and verbal skills) is essential for our remote environment.
* Exceptional organizational skills and prioritization ability to manage multiple customers and incoming requests.
* Familiarity with the following tools: Salesforce, Fathom, Hex, Google Suite, Slack, Hubspot, and Claude.

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and stock equity plan
* Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* Company sponsored pre-tax retirement savings program (401k)
* A flexible work environment that supports working from home
* Flexible PTO
* Parental Leave
* Home office stipend

If you'd rather not, or can't, we'll review your application as submitted after the 10-day window.*

jobs.title: Manager of Implementation & Onboarding
jobs.description:
Tilt (check us out here) is looking for a Manager of Implementation & Onboarding. This role reports to the Director of Customer Experience and oversees the day-to-day execution of Tilt’s customer implementation and onboarding process, ensuring customers launch successfully and understand how Tilt supports their leave management workflows. This role manages and develops the Implementation team, coordinates customer implementations, understands gaps in existing training to support improvements, and holds the team accountable for quality, timeliness, and clear communication.

Working closely with Sales, Product, Leave Support, and Customer Success, the Manager translates department priorities into consistent execution, resolves implementation barriers, and improves processes. The Manager ensures the team understands each customer’s policies and workflows, accurately configures the platform, and prepares customers and internal teams for a successful transition to ongoing support.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Team Management & Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop team members through regular one-on-ones, timely feedback, performance evaluations, and development conversations.
* Set clear expectations for implementation quality, customer communication, responsiveness, and follow-through.
* Assign implementations and balance workloads based on customer complexity, team expertise, and available capacity.
* Ensure team members develop strong product knowledge and can translate customer policies and workflows into accurate implementation requirements.
* Address performance gaps promptly and ensure coverage during absences.

### **Implementation Delivery & Customer Readiness**

* Oversee implementations from Sales handoff through go-live and transition to ongoing support.Ensure every implementation has a documented scope, timeline, milestones, owners, and customer responsibilities.
* Confirm customer requirements, policies, and workflows are understood and documented before configuration.
* Ensure configuration reviews, testing, customer training, and required approvals are completed before launch.
* Monitor implementation progress, address delays, and communicate changes to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Join complex customer calls and own implementation escalations through resolution, escalating to leadership when additional support or decisions are needed.

### **Sales & Implementation Alignment**

* Partner with Sales to ensure complete, accurate handoffs, including customer goals, purchased services, commitments, and implementation requirements.Provide realistic implementation timelines based on scope, dependencies, and team capacity.
* Participate in prospect conversations as needed to explain the implementation process and clarify requirements.
* Identify gaps between sales commitments and implementation capabilities and resolve them with the appropriate leaders.

### **Process Improvement & Efficiency**

* Maintain and reinforce standard implementation processes, documentation, templates, and quality checkpoints.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement practical improvements that reduce delays, manual effort, and rework.
* Partner with Operations to adopt automation and AI tools that improve team capacity and consistency.
* Ensure the team follows established service standards and keeps project records current.
* Use customer feedback and implementation data to evaluate whether process changes improve outcomes.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination & Handoffs**

* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Leave Support, Customer Success, and other partners to resolve implementation dependencies.
* Escalate product gaps and technical barriers with clear descriptions of customer impact, urgency, and required decisions.
* Ensure receiving teams have the documentation, context, and training needed to support customers after launch.
* Confirm ownership and next steps for any approved outstanding items at handoff.
* Maintain internal and customer-facing training resources as products and processes evolve.

### **Performance Management & Reporting**

* Track team performance against established implementation goals and service standards.
* Maintain visibility into implementation status, capacity, delays, risks, and escalations.
* Provide leadership with clear updates, including corrective actions and decisions needed.
* Use performance trends to guide coaching, workload allocation, and process improvements.

**Expectations**
----------------

jobs.title: Growth and Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
\*\*Growth and Customer Success Lead (Founding Role)\*\*

Agiletech· [Remote, US only] · Hourly -commission

**Getting subscriptions and Revenue, That is this job.**

We developed an AI agent for small business's website. It answers customer questions only from that business's own content, cites every reply, and says "I don't know" instead of guessing. The same chat takes online orders from the business's own menu or catalog, runs a kitchen display for restaurants, books appointments and captures leads. Our customers are restaurants, clinics, salons, trades, online stores and support teams: owners who answer the same questions all day and don't have a developer.

We are early. The product is broad and live, and the next step is getting it into the hands of the businesses it was built for.

This is a very fast paced Work, apply only if you are up for it.

\*\*The role\*\*

You will be the first person whose whole job is customers: finding them, signing them up, getting them live and keeping them happy. You will own the path from a stranger hearing about us to a business that pays every month and tells another owner. You will work directly with the founder and have real influence over the product, pricing and what we build next.

\*\*What you'll do\*\*

\*Marketing and visibility\*

- Run our launch and directory listings: Product Hunt, G2, Capterra and the AI and industry directories.

- Write and publish two articles a month for owners, from a keyword plan we already have.

- Build our presence where buyers are, such as restaurant, clinic and e-commerce communities, LinkedIn, Reddit and local business groups, by being useful first.

- Test small paid search campaigns per industry, and stop what doesn't produce trials.

\*Bringing in subscribers\*

- Reach out to restaurants, clinics, salons and stores, show them what their own website can't answer, and run short demos.

- Personally set up the first customers: upload their menu, get the chat on their site, and print their QR code.

- Turn early customers into case studies, reviews and referrals.

\*Growing revenue\*

- Own trial-to-paid conversion. Find where trials stall and fix it with onboarding emails, in-app guidance and timely follow-up.

- Move customers to annual billing, and to higher plans when they outgrow theirs.

- Run launch offers and promotions with our built-in promotional pricing.

- Bring pricing feedback from real conversations to the founder.

\*Supporting customers and the product\*

- Answer support questions by email and chat, with a goal of same-day replies.

- Help owners with setup: menus, ordering, the kitchen display, bookings and the chat widget.

- Keep the FAQ, guides and help articles accurate as the product changes.

- Bring every bug, confusion and feature request back to the product, with the customer's own words attached.

\*\*What success looks like\*\*

- \*\*First 30 days.\*\* You know the product end to end, the directory listings are live, and you have set up your first customers by hand. You have a repeatable way of bringing in trials, a trial-to-paid rate we trust, published case studies, and a support process that doesn't depend on the founder.

- \*\*First year.\*\* You own a growing revenue line and know which channel produces customers at what cost.

\*\*You might be a fit if you\*\*

- Have 3+ years in B2B SaaS growth, customer success, account management or sales, ideally selling to small businesses.

- Can explain a technical product in plain words to a restaurant owner during a lunch rush.

- Write clearly and quickly, from a cold email to a help article to a launch post.

- Are comfortable picking up the phone, walking into a business, and running a demo.

- Look at numbers weekly and change course when something isn't working.

- Like owning an outcome end to end more than owning one slice of it.

\*\*Nice to have\*\*

- Experience with restaurants, hospitality, clinics or e-commerce, or with POS, ordering or booking software.

- SEO and content experience, or a track record with Product Hunt or directory launches.

- Familiarity with Stripe, HubSpot or a similar CRM, and analytics tools.

- Spanish or another second language. Many of our owners and their customers speak more than one.

\*\*How to apply\*\*

Send your resume and a short note to agiletechinc1@gmail.com answering one question: pick a local business near you and tell us what three questions their website doesn't answer. There's no wrong answer. We want to see how you think about a customer.

Pay: $15.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 28.0 per week

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

**Location**: Remote

**Division:** Revenue

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

**Scope of the Job:**

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) is seeking its first Sales Enablement Manager to build our sales enablement function from the ground up. As we refine our brand, product story, and approach to selling, this person will help our sellers clearly explain who we are, what we offer, the customer problems we solve, and how to sell our solutions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set priorities and create the content and training to deliver them. Working closely with Revenue Leadership, Sales Operations, Marketing, Product, and technical experts, you will investigate gaps, bring the right people together, and turn complex information into practical sales resources. You should be comfortable asking difficult questions, constructively challenging assumptions, and following through to get the information and decisions sellers need.

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain a practical sales enablement roadmap and playbook, prioritizing the most urgent seller needs with Revenue Leadership.
* Develop and deliver onboarding and ongoing training covering company and product knowledge, customer use cases, discovery, qualification, demos, and value conversations. Use practice and feedback to assess seller readiness.
* Create and maintain sales presentations, product and use case guides, discovery questions, objection handling, and competitive battle cards. Organize approved resources so sellers can easily find current materials.
* Learn QCi’s products, subsidiaries, target customers, and selling motions through interviews with experts, sales conversations, and existing materials. Partner with Marketing to translate the evolving brand and positioning into clear sales messaging, validated by Product and technical teams.
* Support product launches with seller training, messaging, FAQs, and sales tools. Surface unclear product scope, capabilities, availability, or claims and drive follow-up with the accountable owners before communicating them to sellers.
* Measure adoption, knowledge and skill development, and seller feedback. Partner with Sales Operations and sales leaders to assess business impact and improve programs.
* Coordinate subject matter experts, clarify owners and deadlines, and escalate unresolved dependencies with a clear recommendation. Product and leadership retain ownership of product definition and commercial readiness; Marketing retains ownership of brand and positioning.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in sales enablement, product marketing, sales training, or a related commercial role, with direct ownership of enablement deliverables. Equivalent experience demonstrating the capabilities below will also be considered.
* Demonstrated experience building an enablement program, playbook, or onboarding approach from an early stage, including personally creating materials and delivering training.
* Strong writing, facilitation, and project management skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, accurate customer value and practical sales guidance.
* Ability to work independently amid incomplete information, influence stakeholders without formal authority, ask probing questions, and persist constructively to secure input and resolve blockers. Strong commercial curiosity and the ability to understand customer needs, buying processes, and how sellers move opportunities forward

**Additional Preferred Skills:**

* Experience supporting B2B technology or complex technical sales. Exposure to quantum, photonics, semiconductors, AI, or other deep technology is helpful; prior quantum expertise is not required.
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems and practical approaches to organizing and maintaining enablement content.
* Experience working across Sales, Marketing, Product, and technical teams in an organization with evolving products or multiple selling motions.

**ABOUT LIVE RISKS**

Live Risks helps businesses identify, monitor and manage risks to their operations, assets and supply chains.

We are looking for professionals to **develop new business and manage ongoing client relationships**. You will build a portfolio of business clients, with Live Risks supporting outreach, personalized newsletters, proposals and service delivery.

**THE ROLE**

You will manage ongoing client relationships, discuss risk priorities and coordinate monitoring and management support with Live Risks. You will build new relationships and, as the business grows, manage accounts introduced by Live Risks. Live Risks provides the research, analysis and service delivery support.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Connect regularly with business clients, build trust and maintain lasting relationships.
* Understand clients’ business priorities and coordinate relevant monitoring and management support with Live Risks.
* Work with Live Risks on client reviews, proposals and follow-up on agreed actions.
* Stay involved with your clients, identify opportunities to support more of their business and develop new client relationships.

**HOW WE SUPPORT YOU**

* **Hands-on outreach support**, including personalized messages and follow-up materials.
* **Personalized newsletters** and relevant risk updates you can send to clients and prospects to grow your own risk management brand.
* Support with client meetings, presentations and proposals.
* Risk research, analysis and coordination of agreed client services.
* Client contracting, billing and payment administration.
* Selected client engagements may involve travel, with approved travel expenses covered by Live Risks.

You focus on client relationships, with Live Risks supporting both business development and service delivery.

**COMPENSATION**

Build and manage a portfolio of business clients and earn an ongoing share of the monitoring and management fees Live Risks collects from those accounts.

Client fees are based on the agreed value of the business assets covered by our services, referred to as **assets under risk management**, and the level of support provided. Your compensation is a competitive percentage of those collected fees, giving you the opportunity to grow your income as you develop and retain your client portfolio.

Earned payments are made **every two weeks**. Full compensation terms are agreed before you join.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

Experience selling to businesses or managing client relationships is valuable. Backgrounds in professional services, insurance, consulting, property, manufacturing, logistics or related fields are welcome.

Experience in risk management, insurance, business continuity or operational consulting is preferred and will help you have informed, practical conversations with clients.

We welcome experienced account managers and people earlier in their careers. You should be comfortable starting conversations with business clients, following up consistently and working independently. Existing business relationships are valuable, but you do not need an established client book or technical risk credentials.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and **two or three sentences** about your client relationship or business development experience, any risk management experience, and the industries you know best. A full cover letter is not required.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in risk management, insurance or business continuity? If yes, how many years?
* Do you have existing business clients or professional contacts you could introduce to Live Risks? If yes, which industries? An existing client base is not required.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager. International Payments Testing
new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to join the International Testing Programs (ITP) team within Global Product Quality. In this role, you will own Meta's payments testing programs and contribute to the broader ITP mission of ensuring our products work as intended in every market we serve. You will work on payments testing across Meta's international markets — coordinating in-country validation of payment experiences with real local payment methods, managing the payment instruments Meta teams test with, defining coverage and quality metrics, and applying automation to scale how testing gets delivered.Payments are how people and businesses transact across Meta's family of apps, and simulated test environments only go so far — confirming that payments work takes validation in-market, with the methods people actually use. You will shape how payment experiences are tested across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, and generative AI products, turning results into recommendations that product and engineering teams act on.Beyond payments, you will contribute to the broader International Testing Programs mission of ensuring Meta's products work as intended in every market we serve. That means supporting test coverage, execution, and program operations across the wider portfolio, and helping the team scale through automation — bringing what you learn from payments testing to how international testing gets delivered overall, and vice versa.  
  
  

### **Program Manager. International Payments Testing Responsibilities:**

* Own active payments testing programs — manage day-to-day delivery of end-to-end payment tests executed in-country using real local payment methods, including market and payment method prioritization, test scoping, execution cadence, results triage, and follow-through with product and engineering owners
* Own passive payment credentials programs — manage sourcing, provisioning, and lifecycle of real payment instruments (cards, bank accounts, SIMs, merchant accounts) for Meta teams to test payment flows, working with privacy, legal, compliance, finance, and enterprise infrastructure on handling requirements
* Contribute as an active member of ITP beyond payments — support test coverage, execution, and program operations across the wider portfolio
* Help the team scale through automation and AI tooling that reduces manual execution, triage, and reporting work so coverage grows without headcount growing with it
* Partner with payments product and engineering teams, QA leaders across product areas, external testing partners, analytics teams, localization program managers, and Meta's privacy, legal, compliance, and finance teams
* Design testing methodologies and run in-market validation across multiple geographies simultaneously
* Define coverage and quality metrics for payments testing programs and track results to drive product decisions
* Apply AI and automation as tools to deliver testing faster and at greater scale

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or quality program management
* Experience managing vendor relationships and external testing partners at scale
* Experience with ambiguity and building programs where processes are not yet fully defined
* Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, legal, compliance, and finance teams
* Experience with data-driven decision making and defining program metrics
* Experience communicating program status and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with payments, fintech, or financial services products
* Experience with in-market testing or international quality validation
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with international product launches or localization programs
* Experience with test automation, AI-powered testing tools, or quality engineering practices
* Experience scaling programs through automation rather than headcount growth
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

new_jobs.title: Sales Onboarding Manager
new_jobs.description:
Perplexity is hiring sellers fast, and every new seller has to learn a fast-moving product line: Enterprise, Comet, Computer and the API. We're looking for a Sales Onboarding Manager to own how new sellers go from their first day to selling on their own. You'll build the program, keep it current, run it, and certify that each seller is ready before they sell independently.

This is a high-ownership, highly visible role on a small Sales Enablement team. You'll partner with the Sales Enablement Lead and work closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and Revenue Operations. Your goal is a robust, relevant, progressive and measurable ramp that gets faster as we scale.

**About the role**
------------------

The Sales Onboarding Manager owns the onboarding experience for Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives (AEs) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs), from Day 1 through field certification. You'll design the curriculum, keep it up to date as the product changes, lead the sessions yourself, manage the logistics of placing each cohort into the right sessions, and run the certifications that decide when a new hire is ready.

Company-wide new-hire orientation is owned by a separate onboarding role. Ongoing training for ramped sellers is owned by Sales Enablement. You'll partner with both so new sellers move smoothly from orientation into their sales ramp and then into working independently with ongoing training from Enablement.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own the sales onboarding program.** Co-design and run role-based ramps for BDRs and for Enterprise and Commercial AEs, including learning objectives, milestones and time-to-productivity targets for each stage. Where BDRs and AEs need the same foundations, they learn them together. Where the jobs differ, each gets its own track.
* **Build the BDR ramp.** Teach new BDRs prospecting and outbound: ideal customer profile and persona research, account and territory rules, multi-channel sequences, cold calling, cold email, qualification, and clean handoffs to AEs. Get BDRs productive in the prospecting stack, including Salesforce, Apollo and the dialer.
* **Build and maintain content.** Create and update modules, playbooks, talk tracks, demo guides, knowledge checks and self-paced content. Update materials as products, pricing, positioning and process change, and retire anything out of date.
* **Facilitate live sessions.** Lead engaging, interactive sessions (virtual and in person) on Perplexity's products, sales process, customer personas, discovery, demos, objection handling and tools. Bring in subject-matter experts from Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and top sellers.
* **Run cohort logistics.** Work with Recruiting and sales leaders to track incoming hires, assign each one to the right sessions for their role, segment and start date, and manage calendars, attendance, make-ups and pre-work.
* **Certify field readiness.** Design and run role-specific certifications using clear rubrics. For BDRs, that means cold-call, email and qualification certifications. For AEs, it means pitch, discovery and demo certifications. Both roles also certify on tools. Calibrate scoring with BDR and sales managers, give actionable feedback, and decide when a new hire is ready to sell on their own.
* **Partner with frontline managers.** Give managers visibility into each new hire's progress, flag risks early, and equip managers to reinforce onboarding through coaching and call reviews.
* **Measure and improve.** Track completion, certification pass rates and ramp attainment. For BDRs, also track activity, meetings booked and accepted, and pipeline sourced. For AEs, also track time to first meeting, pipeline and closed business. Use the data and new-hire feedback to improve the program each cohort.
* **Scale with leverage.** Use AI tools, including Perplexity's own products, to build content faster, personalize learning paths and automate repetitive logistics so the program keeps up with hiring.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

The best candidates are strong facilitators who also design programs and run operations well. You can command a room, build a curriculum from a blank page, and keep a complicated cohort calendar running smoothly. You hold a high bar for readiness and know how to tell a manager when a seller isn't there yet.

**Must-haves**

* 2–4 years in sales enablement, sales onboarding or sales training, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or AI company. Experience carrying a quota or managing sellers is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing and running a sales onboarding or ramp program end to end, with measurable impact on ramp time or productivity.
* Excellent live facilitation, virtual and in person, with sellers at different experience levels, from early-career BDRs to seasoned AEs.
* Experience designing and running certifications or skills assessments (such as cold-call, pitch, discovery or demo) using rubrics that sales managers trust.
* Strong program management and operational rigor. You can run several overlapping cohorts, schedules and stakeholders without dropping details.
* Working knowledge of modern sales methods (such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message or similar), outbound prospecting and the full sales cycle from first touch to close.
* Comfort learning technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. You can learn an AI product well enough to teach and demo it.
* Fluency with the sales tech stack, such as Salesforce, a conversation-intelligence tool and an LMS or content-management platform.
* High ownership and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment where the product changes weekly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience onboarding sellers for AI, developer or other technically complex products.
* Background in instructional design or adult learning.
* Previous experience as a BDR/SDR or as a BDR/SDR manager.

new_jobs.title: Research Program Manager, Safety Systems
new_jobs.description:
Research Program Management - San Francisco

**About the Team**

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models. We work across research, engineering, product, and policy to understand risks, develop and validate safeguards, and support responsible deployment.

Our work spans safeguards research and deployment, safety assessments, launch readiness, and trusted-access programs for advanced capabilities. We address risks including biological and cyber misuse and misalignment, with programs that strengthen safety across models and products.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring Research Program Managers across AI Safeguards and Frontier Risks Safety. You’ll lead programs that develop and improve the safeguards used across our models and products, or assess and mitigate risks associated with frontier capabilities, launches, and trusted-access programs.

You will partner with researchers development and deployment decisions. We’re looking for people who combine strong technical judgment, experience managing complex research programs, and a commitment to AI safety.

These roles are based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Shape safety programs and technical roadmaps.** Partner with research and engineering leads to define goals investments.
* **Drive safeguards development and deployment.** Translate safety research into safeguards across models and products. Maintain an end-to-end view of safeguard coverage, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement for one or more risk areas, and drive a roadmap that advances across launches.
* **Coordinate evaluations and safety assessments.** Organize capability evaluations, alignment and control assessments, adversarial testing, and safeguard stress-testing, including risks from autonomous and multi-agent systems. Support embedded assessments throughout model development, internal use, and deployment.
* **Drive safety readiness and trusted-access programs.** Coordinate safety requirements and execution across frontier model launches and deployments. Work with technical teams to define assessment scope and the evidence needed to inform safety and access decisions.
* **Turn findings into improvements.** Triage safeguard gaps, jailbreaks, and overflagging with accountable teams. Establish owners and escalation paths, track remediation and regression testing, and turn recurring issues into research and engineering improvements.
* **Strengthen the evidence behind safety decisions.** Support safety cases that connect claims to evaluations, safeguards, assumptions, and remaining uncertainty. Surface evidence gaps and unresolved risks, and communicate methods, results, limitations, and follow-up actions through assessment reports, system cards, and updates to decision-makers.
* **Build programs that scale across products.** Coordinate shared tooling and feedback workflows, privacy and security requirements, and safeguard user experience and quality assurance. Help teams apply safeguards consistently across product surfaces and upcoming launches.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have 5+ years of experience in technical safety work, owning technical programs, or related roles in fast-moving environments.
* Have led complex research or technical programs involving researchers and engineers, particularly in AI, cybersecurity, biosafety, or another field where failures can have serious consequences.
* Understand frontier AI safety concepts, including capability evaluations, alignment, control, monitoring, and safeguard robustness, and can engage substantively with technical teams.
* Can assess what evaluation results do and do not establish, including methodological limitations, uncertainty, and the difference between model capability and real-world risk.
* Can turn ambiguous questions into clear programs, make practical tradeoffs, and adjust priorities as evidence changes.
* Have worked extensively across research, engineering, and product teams and can coordinate with policy and communications partners.
* Exercise sound judgment when findings are concerning or incomplete, raise unresolved risks constructively, and communicate complex technical work clearly.
* Are motivated to help ensure increasingly capable AI systems remain beneficial and under meaningful human control.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.

  

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

**Compensation**

$239K – $328K + Offers Equity

The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits.

At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems

RFG Advisory is scaling its growth engine, and Revenue Operations sits at the center of it. We are hiring a Revenue Operations Manager with a Marketing Operations lean to mature our outbound motion, sharpen how we score and attribute leads, and build a seamless journey from first marketing touch through frontline sales.

You will partner daily with our Marketing and Business Development teams, own much of our HubSpot configuration, and turn our data into reporting and analysis that leadership acts on. This is a high-impact role with visibility to the C-suite. You will have a corporate Claude account connected to our core systems, and we expect you to put it to work.

**﻿Location:** This role can be in our Birmingham office or remote.

* If in **Birmingham, AL**, our office works a hybrid schedule (3 days in-office, 2 remote).
* If remote, occasional travel to Birmingham will be required including onboarding.

**Reports to:** Senior Director of Revenue Operations

**﻿**

**﻿What You'll Do**

*HubSpot Administration & Systems*

* Own day-to-day administration and configuration of HubSpot Marketing Hub and Sales Hub, including properties, workflows, lifecycle stages, lists, sequences, and user permissions.
* Maintain data quality and governance standards so records stay accurate, deduplicated, and reportable.
* Manage HubSpot's connections to CRM-adjacent tools, and evaluate new tools against real business need.
* Document processes, field definitions, and system changes so the stack stays easy to understand as it grows.

*Outbound & Pipeline Operations*

* Partner with Business Development and Marketing leadership to scale and mature our outbound motion, from list building and sequences to routing and activity tracking.
* Build lead handoff and routing rules that get prospects from Marketing to frontline sales quickly and with full context.
* Define and monitor service levels and conversion rates between funnel stages.

*Lead Scoring & Attribution*

* Refine and maintain lead scoring models using fit and engagement signals, and recalibrate them against closed-won outcomes.
* Build and evolve attribution models that show which campaigns and channels create pipeline and revenue.
* Partner with Marketing on campaign setup, UTM standards, and tracking so attribution data can be trusted.

*Reporting, Analytics & Insights*

* Build and maintain reports and dashboards for Marketing, Business Development, and executive leadership.
* Analyze funnel, campaign, and rep performance data, then interpret what it means and recommend action from a RevOps perspective.
* Present findings clearly to stakeholders up to the C-suite.

*AI & Automation*

* Use your corporate Claude account and its connectors to speed up reporting, analysis, data hygiene, and documentation.
* Spot repetitive work across Marketing and Sales and replace it with automation or AI-assisted workflows.
* Share what works so the broader team adopts it.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Experience**

* 2-5 years of experience in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations.
* Hands-on HubSpot administration and configuration experience, ideally across both Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.
* Experience supporting outbound sales or SDR/BDR teams preferred.
* Experience building lead scoring or attribution models preferred.
* Financial services, RIA, or B2B experience preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical skills with the judgment to turn data into a clear recommendation.
* Clear written and verbal communicator who can translate between Marketing, Sales, and leadership.

new_jobs.title: Operations and Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Loffa Interactive Group builds the software broker-dealers use to meet rules that once took a room full of people: Letters of Free Funds under Regulation T, quarterly broker statements, and prime brokerage agreements. We've done this since 2002. We're a small, fully remote company, and our clients include some of the largest firms on Wall Street.

We need one person to run our projects and our operations team. That work sits with people who are moving on to other jobs here, so you'd take it over and report to our COO.

**A year from now**

Every active project has one current plan and a named owner for each milestone. Our new platform has its first client live, and you ran the QA and go/no-go checks that got it there. The operations team brings its escalations to you. You've carried the evidence for one SOC 1 and SOC 2 audit cycle, and you've answered client vendor reviews on your own.

**What you'll do**

* Own the plan for every project. The new platform comes first. Keep dates, risks, and decisions current, and chase each open item until it has an owner and an answer.
* Run the delivery routine with our developers and QA in Jira, from sprint planning through release readiness.
* Manage the operations team. They run verification and statement work for our clients and track down counterparties when something goes wrong.
* Turn what clients and the team tell you into requirements. Our quarterly statement and prime brokerage products both started when a client described a manual process to us.
* Cover compliance about 10% of the time. You'd answer client vendor reviews and keep policies and audit evidence current. We'll teach you how we do it.
* Use AI tools every day. Ours compare a vendor questionnaire against our policies and file call notes into Jira tickets. You'd use them and make them better.

**What's hard about it**

This job doesn't work from a distance. You'd read the tickets, join the calls, and know on any given day what's stuck and why. If you'd rather oversee through status reports, it's the wrong job.

You'd also be our only project manager, with no project office behind you. And our market takes time to learn. Even with broker-dealer experience, expect months before the whole picture of how firms use our products makes sense.

**Required**

* Experience at or for a broker-dealer, clearing firm, custodian, or prime broker. Any function counts, including operations, compliance, technology, project work, or a vendor serving those firms.
* You've led a project across more than one team, from plan to delivery, as a project manager, team lead, or operations lead.
* Some hands-on time with software delivery: Jira or a similar tool, a Scrum team, or coding of any kind. A little is fine.
* Authorized to work in the United States and available during US business hours.

**Preferred**

* You've managed an operations team or directed its daily work.
* You've personally run project mechanics such as tickets, standups, user acceptance testing, trackers, or written requirements.
* Exposure to compliance work: written policies, vendor risk reviews, SOC audits, or FINRA or SEC exams.
* Experience with Letters of Free Funds, SIA-150 and SIA-151 prime brokerage agreements, or quarterly open position statements.
* A Scrum or PMP certification, SQL or scripting, FINRA licenses, or regular use of AI tools at work.

**Bonus and benefits**

You'd join our profit-sharing plan, which pays out as cash bonuses and 401(k) contributions. Your share depends on company results, your performance, and your tenure, and your title and salary don't figure into it. Profit sharing isn't guaranteed.

We also offer health insurance, a 401(k) with company matching, short-term and long-term disability coverage, paid time off that grows with tenure, and 10 paid market holidays.

The job is fully remote. We have no office to commute to, and travel is rare.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed by 4 December 2026. Include your resume, and tell us about a project you ran and what you personally did on it.

We use AI tools to help organize and compare applications. A person on our team makes every hiring decision. Offers depend on reference checks, a criminal background check, and a pre-employment drug and alcohol screen.

Loffa Interactive Group is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation to apply, email info@loffacorp.com.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

* What base pay are you looking for?

We are executing federally funded programs, including work under an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA), to build production capability and deliver against government milestones.

Terrion is at the transition point between demonstrated science and manufactured product. That transition is a delivery problem, not a research problem. This role exists to execute it, first at the pilot plant and then at commercial scale.

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Project Manager, Capital Projects, is Terrion's on-site owner of capital project delivery. The role first leads the build-out of the pilot production facility near Frederick, from construction and equipment installation through commissioning and operational readiness, against schedules and milestones set by Terrion's federally funded programs. As Terrion moves to commercial scale, the role then leads delivery of the first commercial plant, which is expected to be a substantially larger facility at a site still being selected.

This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory layer above a controls staff. The Senior Project Manager personally builds and maintains the project schedule, cost baseline, and risk register using tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or Excel, and is Terrion's day-to-day point of accountability for the construction, engineering, and vendor partners on each project. Technical design and engineering decisions sit with the Director of Engineering and Terrion's technical leads. This role owns the schedule, budget, coordination, and delivery around them.

**What You Will Do**

**Pilot Facility Build-Out and Commissioning**

* Lead the build-out of the pilot production facility near Frederick, serving as Terrion's on-site project lead from construction through equipment installation, commissioning, and turnover to operations

* Hold Terrion's construction project manager, general contractor, architects, outside engineering firm, and trade contractors accountable to committed dates, including recovery planning when schedules slip

* Coordinate permitting, occupancy, and utility readiness with local authorities, and work with the environmental, safety, and health lead to keep the site compliant with state and local requirements

* Drive long-lead capital equipment procurement to schedule, tracking vendors, purchase orders, lead times, delivery, installation sequencing, and warranty terms, based on specifications developed by the Director of Engineering

* Integrate design, layout, utility, and regulatory requirements across the project so decisions are made with the full site picture in view

* Be on site daily once construction is underway

**Commercial Plant Delivery**

* Lead project delivery for Terrion's first commercial manufacturing plant, carrying lessons from the pilot facility into the commercial schedule, budget, and contracting approach

* Establish the integrated schedule, cost baseline, and contractor and vendor structure for the commercial plant, and travel to the site as construction and commissioning require

* Support site selection, proposal development, and capital planning with schedule basis, basis of estimate, and staffing plans

**Schedule, Cost, and Risk Control**

* Build and maintain the integrated schedule and cost baseline for each project, including budget development, commitment and accrual tracking, variance analysis, estimate at completion, and resource-loading to the work package level

* Administer scope, schedule, and cost changes through a formal change-control process

* Maintain a risk register with a named owner and mitigation plan for each risk, and report top risks and status during program reviews

* Prepare milestone evidence packages, monthly technical and financial reports, and quarterly program reviews, and report regularly on schedule, cost, progress, risks, and required decisions

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate functional leads across engineering, quality, safety, environmental and health, supply chain, procurement, finance, and operations

* Run the project operating cadence, coordinate with company leadership on agreement administration and flow-down obligations, and escalate schedule, cost, resource, or performance issues early enough to allow corrective action

* Help establish the project management processes, tools, and systems a growing company needs to manage capital projects, track deliverables, and report performance

**What You Bring**

We are targeting project managers with 10 or more years of experience delivering hardware, equipment, facilities, or manufactured products against a customer's contract requirements. The strongest candidates have carried a capital expansion, new production line, new facility, or contract production program from plan to delivery, and can describe what slipped, why, and what they did about it.

* Approximately 10 or more years of career experience, with a core focus on leading complex engineering, capital, or industrial manufacturing projects

* Direct responsibility for sizable projects or programs (ideally $10 million or more in total

new_jobs.title: Senior Information Assurance Analyst / Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC**

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC, we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

**Location:** This is a US-based remote position, with occasional on-site visits to Arlington, VA as required (travel at employee's expense).

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Security Clearance:** No security clearance required. Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Job Summary**
---------------

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking a Senior Information Assurance (IA) Analyst / Program Manager to support the Headquarters, Department of the Army G-1, Directorate of Prevention, Resilience, and Readiness (DPRR) Information Assurance Support Services (IASS) program. This key personnel role leads the Information Assurance program for the Drug and Alcohol Management Information System (DAMIS), the Risk Reduction Unit Risk Inventory Application, and associated standalone applications hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud. Serving as the Information Assurance Security Officer (IASO) and the Contracting Officer Representative's (COR) main point of contact, this position owns Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance, continuous monitoring, and Authority to Operate (ATO) maintenance and reauthorization, and supervises the IA Analyst. Core hours are 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the overall Information Assurance program for DAMIS under the direction of the System Owner/COR and the Program Information Systems Security Manager (P-ISSM), serving as IASO and the COR's main point of contact.
* Manage the system's Risk Management Framework (RMF) process; prepare, coordinate, and submit security documentation for review and routing to the approving authority, and adapt to changing requirements from TBAI, Army CIO, or DoW.
* Use the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS) to obtain and maintain the system ATO; perform weekly continuous monitoring of ATO requirements, STIGs, and Control Correlation Identifiers (CCIs) and report weekly ATO status with a remediation plan.
* Develop and maintain the RMF modernization and timeline plan with ATO milestones, and prepare and submit the ATO reauthorization package in eMASS before the current ATO expires.
* Manage the vulnerability compliance report and lead annual contingency, security, and recovery tests, submitting documentation within 2 business days of test completion.
* Prepare FISMA-compliant reports and update information assurance data in the Army Portfolio Management System (APMS), Army Asset & Vulnerability Tracking Resource (A&VTR), and eMASS.
* Prepare and submit the Monthly Status Report (MSR) on RMF compliance, challenges, issues, and prior-month activity.
* Serve as a member of the agency's Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT), acknowledging incidents within 15 minutes and initiating approved mitigation within one hour during duty hours; maintain the Emergency Operations Plan.
* Review system change requests and recommend implementation or alternatives based on IA vulnerabilities within 2 business days.
* Attend IA working groups, conferences, and recurring meetings virtually or in person, and provide minutes and recommendations within 2 business days.
* Supervise the IA Analyst, review deliverables for quality, and provide backup coverage for IA Analyst tasks.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
* At least 6 years of technical and compliance experience maintaining a system's security posture and managing security within a Microsoft Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environment.
* At least 2 years of experience leading teams.
* Proven IA/cybersecurity experience managing the security posture of systems involving .NET, Windows, Azure, Oracle, and Red Hat.
* Strong background in data architecture, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Red Hat and Windows security and administration.
* Extensive experience implementing and auditing against DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists to oversee RMF processes and continuous monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain a system's ATO and obtain a new ATO.
* Experience using eMASS.
* Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical staff, program leadership, and Government stakeholders.
* Active favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (NACI) or higher federal background investigation prior to start.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Common Access Card (CAC).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with ACAS, SCAP Compliance Checker, and DISA STIG Viewer.
* Experience supporting systems through RMF changes such as the transition from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 4 to Revision 5.
* Experience supporting Army systems hosted in the cArmy Azure Cloud.
* Experience with systems handling Privacy Act, PII, or HIPAA-protected data.
* Experience with FISMA reporting in APMS and A&VTR.

**Certifications**
------------------

* Active Tier 3 (NACI) or higher background investigation prior to start.
* DoD 8570 IAM Level II certification (e.g., CISSP, CGRC/CAP, CISM, GSLC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment.
* DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC) required at time of hire and maintained throughout employment. CISSP satisfies both IAM Level II and IAT Level II.

new_jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess/MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all sizes.

We’re look for a Program Manager to oversee the FedRAMP certification process, as well as ongoing management and evolution of our existing compliance commitments, including SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS compliance. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. If you have a disability, please let us know if there’s any way we can make the interview process better for you; we’re happy to accommodate!

#### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

**Base salary range:** $175,000 - $200,000 USD

new_jobs.title: Manager of Implementation & Onboarding
new_jobs.description:
Tilt (check us out here) is looking for a Manager of Implementation & Onboarding. This role reports to the Director of Customer Experience and oversees the day-to-day execution of Tilt’s customer implementation and onboarding process, ensuring customers launch successfully and understand how Tilt supports their leave management workflows. This role manages and develops the Implementation team, coordinates customer implementations, understands gaps in existing training to support improvements, and holds the team accountable for quality, timeliness, and clear communication.

Working closely with Sales, Product, Leave Support, and Customer Success, the Manager translates department priorities into consistent execution, resolves implementation barriers, and improves processes. The Manager ensures the team understands each customer’s policies and workflows, accurately configures the platform, and prepares customers and internal teams for a successful transition to ongoing support.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Team Management & Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop team members through regular one-on-ones, timely feedback, performance evaluations, and development conversations.
* Set clear expectations for implementation quality, customer communication, responsiveness, and follow-through.
* Assign implementations and balance workloads based on customer complexity, team expertise, and available capacity.
* Ensure team members develop strong product knowledge and can translate customer policies and workflows into accurate implementation requirements.
* Address performance gaps promptly and ensure coverage during absences.

### **Implementation Delivery & Customer Readiness**

* Oversee implementations from Sales handoff through go-live and transition to ongoing support.Ensure every implementation has a documented scope, timeline, milestones, owners, and customer responsibilities.
* Confirm customer requirements, policies, and workflows are understood and documented before configuration.
* Ensure configuration reviews, testing, customer training, and required approvals are completed before launch.
* Monitor implementation progress, address delays, and communicate changes to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Join complex customer calls and own implementation escalations through resolution, escalating to leadership when additional support or decisions are needed.

### **Sales & Implementation Alignment**

* Partner with Sales to ensure complete, accurate handoffs, including customer goals, purchased services, commitments, and implementation requirements.Provide realistic implementation timelines based on scope, dependencies, and team capacity.
* Participate in prospect conversations as needed to explain the implementation process and clarify requirements.
* Identify gaps between sales commitments and implementation capabilities and resolve them with the appropriate leaders.

### **Process Improvement & Efficiency**

* Maintain and reinforce standard implementation processes, documentation, templates, and quality checkpoints.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement practical improvements that reduce delays, manual effort, and rework.
* Partner with Operations to adopt automation and AI tools that improve team capacity and consistency.
* Ensure the team follows established service standards and keeps project records current.
* Use customer feedback and implementation data to evaluate whether process changes improve outcomes.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination & Handoffs**

* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Leave Support, Customer Success, and other partners to resolve implementation dependencies.
* Escalate product gaps and technical barriers with clear descriptions of customer impact, urgency, and required decisions.
* Ensure receiving teams have the documentation, context, and training needed to support customers after launch.
* Confirm ownership and next steps for any approved outstanding items at handoff.
* Maintain internal and customer-facing training resources as products and processes evolve.

### **Performance Management & Reporting**

* Track team performance against established implementation goals and service standards.
* Maintain visibility into implementation status, capacity, delays, risks, and escalations.
* Provide leadership with clear updates, including corrective actions and decisions needed.
* Use performance trends to guide coaching, workload allocation, and process improvements.

**Expectations**
----------------

* **Accountability & Follow-Through**Own the team’s execution and implementation outcomes. Identify missed commitments early, establish corrective actions, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Customer Communication & Partnership**Ensure customers receive proactive updates, clear expectations, and timely answers. Lead prepared, productive meetings with documented decisions and next steps.
* **Reliability & Availability**Maintain dependable availability for customers, team members, and cross-functional partners. Attend and facilitate scheduled meetings, arrange coverage when needed, and communicate changes promptly.
* **Proactive Problem-Solving**Anticipate risks, act before issues become escalations, and bring recommendations when leadership input is required.
* **Team Expertise & Coaching**Build a team that understands Tilt’s product and each customer’s operational needs. Reinforce accuracy, sound judgment, empathy, and continuous learning.
* **Data-Informed Improvement**Use metrics, quality reviews, and feedback to improve delivery. Pursue efficiency through better processes, automation, and AI while maintaining implementation quality.

**Key Metrics for Success**
---------------------------

* **Time to Implementation:** Implementation duration by customer segment and complexity, with clear visibility into causes of delay.
* **On-Time Milestone & Go-Live Attainment:** Percentage of implementation
